caption.body:
Free export starter PDF: plan your first shipment in five steps.

Many beginners know they want to export but do not know what to do first. This PDF puts the order in one place: choose a product and its HS code, shortlist markets and buyers, line up the documents, check the buyer and agree payment terms, and run a final checklist before shipping.

It is a planning guide, not legal or customs advice. Confirm current rules with your customs broker or the official sites.

leadmagnet.title: Export Starter Checklist
leadmagnet.subtitle: Plan your first shipment in five steps

sections.heading: 1. Product and market
items: Choose one product you can supply reliably
Shortlist 2-3 target countries using trade data

sections.heading: 2. Buyers and documents
items: Prepare a company profile, price sheet and samples
Learn the documents: invoice, packing list, shipping bill, transport document

sections.heading: 3. Check, agree, ship
items: Verify each buyer before you quote
Agree payment terms and Incoterms in writing
Confirm rules and labelling with your customs broker
Run the final checklist and keep copies of everything

leadmagnet.closing: Follow my account for more export business tips
